aiCommitLite.description: Generate conventional commit messages using providers such as OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, DeepSeek, Gemini, Anthropic, Cohere, Mistral, and Qwen/DashScope
aiCommitLite.apiKey: API key for the selected provider
aiCommitLite.apiEndpoint: API base URL for Azure or OpenAI-compatible providers. Usually this should end with `/v1`. Examples: `https://api.openai.com/v1`, `https://api.deepseek.com/v1`. Do not use a website homepage or documentation page URL.
aiCommitLite.model: Model name to use (e.g., gpt-3.5-turbo, gpt-4, deepseek-chat, gemini-pro)
aiCommitLite.commitMessageStyle: Preferred commit message style (`detailed` adds bullet details, `concise` keeps a single subject line)
aiCommitLite.temperature: Temperature for AI generation (higher = more creative)
aiCommitLite.contextExcludePatterns: Glob patterns for staged files that should be summarized instead of sending the full diff to the AI context
aiCommitLite.maxDiffCharacters: Maximum number of diff characters sent to AI after filtering and summarization
aiCommitLite.maxFileDiffCharacters: Maximum number of diff characters from a single file before truncation
aiCommitLite.enableAutoFallback: Enable automatic fallback when quota exceeded
aiCommitLite.profileFallbackOrder: Preferred fallback order when current profile fails
